gaps: Sign in as the separate approver user and verify that the PO is specifically assigned to Vendor B.

plan.title: Award RFQ to Vendor B and generate PO

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ with bids from the buyer side.
Open the comparison grid needed for awarding.
Allocate the full award to Vendor B and submit the proposal.
Assert that the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the separate approver user, approve the submitted proposal with a remark, and complete approval until the PO for Vendor B is created

steps.note: The separate approver login and vendor-specific PO verification are not available to catalog steps.
Complete or read back the purchase order after approval.
Assert that the generated PO contains the awarded product line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the event's history placement.
Open the History tab as required by the expected outcome.
Assert that the awarded event appears in History.
